title: 隧道仰拱閉合施工~Tunnel invert closure
focus: 以閉合環、接頭相容與基底反力解析隧道仰拱~Analyze tunnel inverts through ring closure, joint compatibility and base reactions
summary: 本課以以閉合環、接頭相容與基底反力解析隧道仰拱為主線，從閉合環與環向力與仰拱曲率與力線建立系統邊界，再把閉合距離與時間效應、地下水浮力與排水狀態連到永久環與維護交接。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on analyze tunnel inverts through ring closure, joint compatibility and base reactions. It begins with Ring closure and hoop force and Invert curvature and force trajectory, links Closure distance and time effects and Groundwater uplift and drainage state, and ends with Permanent ring and maintenance handover. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 閉合環與環向力~Ring closure and hoop force
units.title: 閉合環與環向力~Ring closure and hoop force
units.mechanism: 拱部與仰拱接成閉合環後，部分地層作用可由環向壓力傳遞，開口環則更依賴拱腳反力與彎曲。閉合不是外觀接觸而已，接頭必須能傳遞所需作用；模型應保留閉合前已發生的變形，不能把全部荷載重新從零分配。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態；若出現接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Closure allows ground actions to transfer partly through hoop compression, whereas an open arch relies more on foot reaction and bending. Visible contact is not sufficient joint transfer. Retain preclosure deformation rather than reallocating the complete load from an artificial zero state. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. If an intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 混凝土外觀連成一圈就等於受力環已完全閉合~Concrete appearing as a circle proves complete structural ring closure
units.practice: 將比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 仰拱曲率與力線~Invert curvature and force trajectory
units.title: 仰拱曲率與力線~Invert curvature and force trajectory
units.mechanism: 仰拱曲率影響軸力作用線與基底接觸，過度平坦可能增加彎曲需求。局部厚度和曲率誤差互相影響，不能只量最低點高程；應將設計曲線與完成面配準，辨認轉折、接頭及基底鬆動造成的非均勻受力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以斷面掃描檢核曲率、厚度與接頭附近的幾何轉折；若出現局部平坦區使力線偏心，形成表面與背面的交替裂紋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Invert curvature governs the thrust trajectory and base contact, and flattening can increase bending demand. Thickness and curvature errors interact, so the lowest elevation alone is insufficient. Register the completed profile to identify kinks, joints and uneven loading from disturbed ground. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Use section scans to check curvature, thickness and geometric kinks near joints. If a locally flat zone shifts the thrust line and causes alternating-face cracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 拱腳接頭與剪力傳遞~Foot joints and shear transfer
units.title: 拱腳接頭與剪力傳遞~Foot joints and shear transfer
units.mechanism: 拱腳接頭把拱部作用帶入仰拱，粗糙面、鋼筋與混凝土接觸共同決定傳力。界面有泥膜或空隙時，名義面積不能全數參與；剪力模型須區分摩擦、黏結及鋼筋作用，並考慮正向力在施工階段可能改變。 判別這個機制時，應觀察查核接面清理、鋼筋連續及接頭滑移量測；若出現泥膜讓摩擦與黏結降低，仰拱形成局部滑移縫，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Foot joints transfer arch action through interface roughness, reinforcement and contact. Mud films or gaps prevent the full nominal area engaging. Separate friction, cohesion and reinforcement mechanisms and recognize that normal force changes during construction rather than remaining permanently clamped. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check interface preparation, reinforcement continuity and measured joint slip. If a mud film reduces friction and bond and creates a localized sliding joint, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 基底擾動與承壓~Base disturbance and bearing
units.title: 基底擾動與承壓~Base disturbance and bearing
units.mechanism: 開挖底部可能因積水、車輛或卸載而擾動，名義岩盤不一定仍有原來剛度。仰拱與基底需保持預期接觸，空隙會把連續反力變成局部支點；以平均壓力檢核時仍須另查最小接觸面積及可壓縮夾層。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對基底地質、水軟化區及仰拱下接觸證據；若出現軟弱夾層壓密使仰拱差異沉陷並拉開接頭，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Water, traffic and unloading disturb the base, so nominal rock need not retain its original stiffness. Gaps convert distributed support into local bearings. Mean-pressure checks therefore need separate evidence for minimum contact and compressible seams rather than assuming an undisturbed continuous foundation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check base geology, water-softened zones and evidence of invert contact. If a compressible seam settles unevenly and opens invert joints, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 閉合距離與時間效應~Closure distance and time effects
units.title: 閉合距離與時間效應~Closure distance and time effects
units.mechanism: 掌子面到閉合位置的距離控制地層處於開口環狀態的長度，但相同距離在不同進尺速度下代表不同等待時間。地層有時效時，距離與時間都影響收斂；不能將一個工程的閉合距離直接當作所有地層的通用標準。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將閉合位置、進尺速度及收斂速率放在共同時間軸；若出現進尺變慢但距離不變，等待時間增加而收斂持續累積，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Face-to-closure distance controls the length remaining as an open ring, but equal distances imply different waiting times at different advance rates. Time-dependent ground requires both measures. A closure distance from one project is not a universal criterion for every ground condition. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Align closure location, advance rate and convergence rate on a common timeline. If slower advance increases waiting time and accumulated convergence at unchanged distance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 施工車輛與早齡載入~Construction traffic and early loading
units.title: 施工車輛與早齡載入~Construction traffic and early loading
units.mechanism: 仰拱完成後可能很快承受施工車輛，輪載屬局部作用而非均勻環壓。早齡混凝土、回填保護層與基底一起決定應力分散，單靠成熟混凝土強度不能代表當天狀態；應將短期交通荷載列入獨立階段。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較車輛荷載、保護層厚度與當日混凝土成熟證據；若出現保護層不足使局部早齡裂損被後續回填遮住，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Construction traffic may reach an invert soon after casting, applying local wheel actions rather than uniform ring pressure. Young concrete, cover fill and ground control load spread. Mature strength does not represent the day of loading, so treat traffic as a separate temporary stage. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare vehicle loads and cover depth with concrete maturity on the loading day. units.anchor: 地下水浮力與排水狀態~Groundwater uplift and drainage state
units.title: 地下水浮力與排水狀態~Groundwater uplift and drainage state
units.mechanism: 底部水頭可向上作用，排水可靠性決定是否能維持設計假設。自重、結構連接與地層反力必須在同一自由體中比較，不能把同一份摩擦或覆重重複計入；排水堵塞情境通常需要另建荷載組合。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步查看底部水壓、集水流量及仰拱垂直位移；若出現排水堵塞讓底壓升高，原先穩定仰拱出現抬升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Water head acts upward and drainage reliability determines whether the assumed condition persists. Compare weight, connections and ground reactions in one free body without double-counting friction or overburden. A blocked-drain state generally needs its own loading combination and contact assessment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare base pressure, collection flow and vertical invert movement simultaneously. If blocked drainage raises base pressure and lifts an otherwise stable invert, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 收斂閉合與儀器對時~Convergence closure and synchronization
units.title: 收斂閉合與儀器對時~Convergence closure and synchronization

Multidirectional convergence distinguishes foot movement, base heave and overall settlement. Preserve chord lengths and reference changes so a curve break is not automatically interpreted as structural improvement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time. If a reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 接縫漏水與耐久~Joint leakage and durability
units.title: 接縫漏水與耐久~Joint leakage and durability
units.mechanism: 仰拱接縫接近積水和沉積物，漏水可能沿施工界面連通到兩側。水量增加不一定表示裂縫擴大，也可能是水頭上升或排水改道；維修前應把接縫開口、化學環境與排水歷史配對，避免堵住唯一的洩壓通路。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照接縫開口、水頭及同區排水量的同步紀錄；若出現只封出水口使底壓升高，漏水轉移到鄰近接縫，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Invert joints encounter water and sediment, and leakage can spread along construction interfaces. Increasing flow may reflect head rise or rerouting rather than wider cracks. Pair opening, chemistry and drainage history before repair to avoid sealing the only pressure-relief path. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare synchronized joint opening, head and local drainage flow. If sealing an outlet raises base pressure and moves leakage to another joint, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 永久環與維護交接~Permanent ring and maintenance handover
units.title: 永久環與維護交接~Permanent ring and maintenance handover
units.mechanism: 施工仰拱、填充層和永久路面可能同時存在，卻有不同承載與排水角色。維修開槽若誤切結構仰拱，會破壞環向傳力，原圖未標高程時尤其難辨認；交接應提供可追溯的分層幾何及禁止任意切割的結構界面。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將竣工分層高程、排水位置與結構接頭編入維護圖；若出現把結構仰拱當填充層開槽，切斷原本閉合的受力環，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Structural invert, fill and pavement have different loading and drainage roles despite sharing the same section. Maintenance cuts into the structural invert interrupt ring transfer, particularly where layer levels are unclear. Handover must preserve layered geometry and identify structural interfaces requiring engineering review. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record as-built layer levels, drain locations and structural joints in maintenance drawings. If treating structural invert as fill and cutting it interrupts the closed load path, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查閉合環與環向力：N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m；再獨立檢查仰拱曲率與力線：eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m。半徑 4 m 固定，壓力由 0.15 增為 0.18 MPa，理想環力由 0.60 增為 0.72 MN/m；這不含接頭彎矩和基底不均勻反力。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 將把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Ring closure and hoop force: N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m. Independently check Invert curvature and force trajectory: eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m. At a fixed 4 m radius, raising pressure from 0.15 to 0.18 MPa increases ideal-ring thrust from 0.60 to 0.72 MN/m, excluding joint moments and uneven base reactions. The two results are not a complete design because an intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. Use register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的以閉合環、接頭相容與基底反力解析隧道仰拱，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on analyze tunnel inverts through ring closure, joint compatibility and base reactions reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

假想檢核 3：拱腳接頭與剪力傳遞；frictionResistance=mu*N=0.5*400 kN=200 kN, neglecting other mechanisms~Assumed check 3: Foot joints and shear transfer; frictionResistance=mu*N=0.5*400 kN=200 kN, neglecting other mechanisms
假想檢核 4：基底擾動與承壓；q=load/contactArea=1200 kN/6 m2=200 kPa~Assumed check 4: Base disturbance and bearing; q=load/contactArea=1200 kN/6 m2=200 kPa
假想檢核 5：閉合距離與時間效應；waitingTime=distance/rate=12 m/(3 m/day)=4 day~Assumed check 5: Closure distance and time effects; waitingTime=distance/rate=12 m/(3 m/day)=4 day
假想檢核 6：施工車輛與早齡載入；contactPressure=wheelLoad/contactArea=60 kN/0.12 m2=500 kPa~Assumed check 6: Construction traffic and early loading; contactPressure=wheelLoad/contactArea=60 kN/0.12 m2=500 kPa
